newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA SELLS STOCK BREEDING FIRM FOR $550,000.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA SELLS STOCK BREEDING FIRM FOR $550,000.

text.p: Bulgaria's Privatisation Agency said on Tuesday it had sold 79 percent of Industrial and Hybrid Stock Breeding company to Bulgaria's Brothers Commerce Ltd. for $550,000.

Under the deal the buyer is to pay 50 percent of the price in cash on the day of the signing the contract and the remaining 50 percent in government bad debt bonds or Zunks up to 30 working days after that.
Brothers Commerce Ltd. has also pledged to invest additional 380 million levs in the the Shumen-based firm over the next five years.
The Industrial and Hybrid Stock Breeding company is breeding pigs for production of pork and leather for the local market.
